parameters.content:
## Generate weekly client reports with Google Sheets, Gemini and Gmail approval

For agencies and consultants who prepare recurring client updates from spreadsheet performance data and work notes. This template compares completed reporting periods, calculates verified KPI changes, and asks Gemini for a short narrative without numbers. Code builds the numeric table and escapes report content. A reviewer sees the complete outgoing email before Gmail can deliver it.

### How it works
Run the built-in fictional demo, or read active clients and matching period rows from Google Sheets. Validate data, calculate changes, draft a summary, preview the report, request approval, record SENDING, send once, then save the Gmail message ID and final status.

### Setup
Start with Try Demo: default demo mode uses no credentials, APIs or spreadsheet writes. For live mode, create the documented tabs, configure spreadsheet_id and sender_name, bind Sheets/Gemini/Gmail credentials, and select the optional error workflow. Test with a controlled mailbox before disabling demo mode.

The schedule is disabled and the export inactive. Data comes from Ads Data rows, not a direct advertising API. Live approval is sequential; interrupted PENDING_APPROVAL or SENDING rows require operator review.

## Demo and configuration
Default demo mode uses fictional data and makes no external calls. Configure spreadsheet ID and sender name before live mode. Keep the schedule disabled until controlled testing passes.

## Select clients and periods
Read active clients. An optional ISO period_end overrides the previous completed Monday–Sunday week in the client timezone. Skip protected report states. Single execution only; Sheets is not an atomic lock.

## Join and validate
Match context and Ads Data by client and exact period. Enter source=sheet. Use numeric metrics, fraction conversion rates and semicolon-separated work notes. Missing or inconsistent data becomes DATA_ERROR.

## Calculate and draft
Code calculates KPI changes. Gemini writes a short summary without numbers. Malformed or numeric summaries are rejected. The deterministic table preserves metric meanings. Human review remains necessary for prose accuracy.

## Review the complete report
Demo returns a preview only. Live mode stores the exact subject and body, then asks the reviewer to approve the entire email. Rejection or timeout sends nothing. Each approval can delay later clients.

## Send and recover
Record SENDING before Gmail. No automatic Gmail retries. Verify its message ID before SENT. Interrupted PENDING_APPROVAL or SENDING rows stay protected: inspect executions and Gmail before resetting. Follow the recovery guide.
